instructions: Provides current conditions and forecasts from public weather data.

tools.name: get_current_conditions
tools.description: Returns the current temperature, humidity, wind speed and conditions for a location. Data is refreshed every ten minutes from the national weather service.

location.description: City name or postal code, for example 'Prayagraj'.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Returns a daily forecast covering up to fourteen days. Each day includes high and low temperature, precipitation probability and a short summary of expected conditions.

country_code.description: Optional ISO country code to disambiguate the city.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Searches the location database by name and returns matching places with their coordinates and time zone.

query.description: Partial place name to search for.

prompts.name: trip_planner
prompts.description: Summarises the forecast for a destination over a date range.
